:::{#exm-eigenvectors-independent}
#### Independent eigenvectors

The eigenvectors $(1, 1)$ for $3$ and $(1, -1)$ for $1$ of @exm-eigenvalue
are linearly independent, as @thm-eigenvectors-independent says they must be:
$c_1 (1, 1) + c_2 (1, -1) = (c_1 + c_2, c_1 - c_2)$ is $\vzero$ only if

$$
\begin{aligned}
c_1 &= c_2 \\
&= 0.
\end{aligned}
$$

Two eigenvectors for the same eigenvalue need not be independent:
$(1, 1)$ and $(2, 2)$ are both eigenvectors for $3$.

:::
